Synthetic Master Service Agreement
Vendor: Aurora Demo Hosting LLC
Client: Northstar Test Operations
Scope of Services
The vendor will provide monitoring, maintenance, and alerting services for the synthetic environment.
Term
The agreement begins on January 1 and continues for twelve months.
Payment
Client will pay a monthly fee according to the statement of work.
Confidentiality
Both parties will protect confidential information and restrict disclosure.
Limitation of Liability
Liability is limited to the fees paid during the prior quarter.
Governing Law
This agreement is governed by Alaska law.

# Synthetic Access Control Policy
## Purpose
Define baseline access controls for the local classifier environment.
## Scope
Applies to operators, support users, and service accounts.
## Policy
Use least privilege, rotate credentials, log access changes, and require change approval for production access.
## Procedure
Review access monthly, remove stale accounts, and document emergency elevation.
## Enforcement
Violations are reviewed by operations leadership.

Synthetic Incident Postmortem

Severity: High

Environment: Production-like lab

Timeline: Alert fired at 09:14, rollback completed at 09:27.

Root Cause: Misrouted BGP advertisements caused packet loss between edge routers.

Corrective Actions: Tighten route filters, update the runbook, and validate rollback procedures weekly.

Synthetic Weekly Project Status Report
Owner: Platform Team
Status: On track
Completed this week: taxonomy sync cleanup, benchmark endpoint validation, and readiness report wiring.
Current blockers: waiting for broader teacher-approved synthetic coverage.
Next steps: execute readiness sweep, review disagreements, and finalize ingestion enablement checklist.

# Synthetic Classifier Architecture Notes
- FastAPI upload endpoint receives files and stages them to the input area.
- The taxonomy router narrows public categories before the model prompt is built.
- LightGBM predicts likely labels and disagreement risk.
- The shadow LLM reviews queued records and approves training rows.
- Retraining updates the local routing model without editing source code.

Synthetic Recovery Runbook

Purpose: restore the classifier API after an outage.

Procedure: verify health, rebuild the API image, restart the service, and confirm categories plus corrections endpoints.

Validation: upload synthetic fixtures, inspect disagreements, and log the change in operations notes.

Synthetic Vendor Review Policy
Purpose: define how the team approves new software vendors.
Policy: collect security questionnaires, review terms, confirm retention limits, and document business justification.
Procedure: operations and legal review the request before contract execution.
Review cycle: every six months.
